data.name: Haythamah
data.gender_notes: Haythamah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haythamah means 'soft-hearted' or 'tender' in Arabic. It is derived from the word 'haytham', which means 'a soft and tender thing'. The name Haythamah carries the meaning “Soft-hearted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Haythamah usually hope their child will grow to embody soft-hearted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being soft-hearted or tender in nature is considered a spiritual quality, as it reflects compassion and kindness towards others. This name signifies a person who is gentle, understanding, and caring.
data.etymology: Haythamah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft-hearted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haythamah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: هيثامة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مؤنث، ذو أصل عربي أصيل، يطلق على المرأة التي تتميز بجمالها وذكائها
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسمُ عَربِيّ مؤنثٌ يُشتقُّ من الجذر العربيّ "هَيثَم" الذي يُعني "الجمال" و"الذكاء". يُصَفُ بِالجمالِ وِالذكاءِ، ولهُ جذورٌ تاريخيةٌ في الثقافةِ العربيةِ الإسلاميةِ. يُعتبرُ اسمًا رفيعًا وذو صيتٍ جيدٍ في العالمِ الإسلاميّ.

in_urdu.name: ہيثامہ
in_urdu.meaning: خوبصورت اور سمجھدار عورت کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہيثامہ ایک عربی اصیل نام ہے جو "خوبصورتی اور ذھانت" کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ یہ اسلامی تہذیب میں ایک درجہ دار اور پسندیدہ نام سمجھا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام اردو زبان میں بھی بہت عام ہے۔
